$comment: Prompt manifest for building sprites. Each entry is generated three times, once per faction variant, using the faction's form language from art/style.md. `seedBase` is offset per faction (0=aegis, 1=noctis, 2=veyra) to keep generations reproducible and distinct.

conyard.aegis: a large hexagonal industrial command headquarters building viewed from directly above, olive-drab and gunmetal modular armour panels, a central raised command tower with a rotating radar dish, floodlights, vehicle bay doors, cable conduits and a landing pad marking. Weathered paint, exhaust staining.
conyard.noctis: a large organic hive command structure viewed from directly above, grown from layered bruised purple-black chitin plates, a central pulsating bio-core visible through a ribbed membrane dome, veined tendrils anchoring it to the ground, glowing violet bioluminescent seams and small brood sacs clustered at the base.
conyard.veyra: a large elegant crystalline command nexus viewed from directly above, a radially symmetric white-gold ceramic structure with a massive glowing amethyst crystal core at the centre, floating unsupported outer ring segments hovering above the ground, hairline energy channels radiating outward, serene and monumental.

power.aegis: a compact fusion reactor building viewed from directly above, a cylindrical containment core surrounded by radial cooling fins, exposed pipework, warning stripes, venting steam and cyan reactor glow visible through a reinforced viewport grid. Olive-drab and gunmetal.
power.noctis: a bulbous organic spore reactor structure viewed from directly above, a pulsating membranous sac ribbed with dark chitin struts, venting spore clouds from small vents, glowing violet internal light diffusing through the thin membrane, root tendrils gripping the ground.
power.veyra: a slender crystalline flux pylon viewed from directly above, a tapering white-gold ceramic spire with a glowing amethyst crystal suspended at its core, three floating unsupported energy rings orbiting the shaft at different heights, hairline light channels radiating outward.

refinery.aegis: an industrial ore refinery and processing plant viewed from directly above, large storage silos, conveyor gantries, smokestacks with light haze, loading docks with ore chutes, pipework and hazard-striped catwalks. Olive-drab and gunmetal, rust streaks.
refinery.noctis: an organic biomass processing structure viewed from directly above, a cluster of swollen digestive sacs connected by ribbed tendon conduits, a central grinding maw-like intake, dripping enzymatic residue, glowing violet internal bioluminescence.
refinery.veyra: an elegant crystalline resource assimilator viewed from directly above, a radial arrangement of tall faceted amethyst crystal spires around a central white-gold ceramic collector dish, floating unsupported conduits linking them, hairline glowing energy channels.

barracks.aegis: a military infantry training and deployment barracks building viewed from directly above, a long modular structure with a vehicle entrance bay, antenna mast, stacked shipping-style module blocks, floodlights and hazard-striped doors. Olive-drab and gunmetal, weathered.
barracks.noctis: an organic spawning pit structure viewed from directly above, a wide fleshy pit ringed by ribbed chitin walls, a central birthing sac pulsating with violet light, larval chitin husks scattered around the rim, wet organic sheen.
barracks.veyra: an ornate crystalline disciple gate viewed from directly above, twin curved white-gold ceramic archway pillars framing a shimmering amethyst energy portal at the centre, floating unsupported halo rings above each pillar, hairline glowing channels.

warfactory.aegis: a heavy vehicle production war factory building viewed from directly above, a large industrial hall with a wide roller door, overhead gantry crane rails, stacked armour plating stock, welding sparks and stencilled hazard markings. Olive-drab and gunmetal.
warfactory.noctis: a massive organic gene forge structure viewed from directly above, a cavernous ribbed chitin dome with a central mutation vat glowing deep violet, thick tendon conduits feeding into it, dripping amniotic fluid at the exit maw.
warfactory.veyra: a grand crystalline forge sanctum viewed from directly above, a wide circular white-gold ceramic platform ringed by tall faceted amethyst crystal pillars, a glowing forging matrix at the centre, floating unsupported architecture, serene symmetry.

airfield.aegis: a military airfield flight control building viewed from directly above, a control tower with radar array, an adjoining hangar with open bay doors, a painted landing pad chevron, fuel tanks and runway edge lighting. Olive-drab and gunmetal.
airfield.noctis: an organic sky nest structure viewed from directly above, a tall ribbed chitin spire with wide membrane launch platforms extending outward like wings, roosting alcoves, glowing violet bioluminescent veins, wet organic sheen.
airfield.veyra: an elegant crystalline star portal viewed from directly above, a large circular white-gold ceramic ring standing on end conceptually flattened to a top-down glowing amethyst portal disc, floating unsupported outer struts, radiant energy patterns.

techlab.aegis: a military science research directorate building viewed from directly above, a hexagonal facility with satellite dishes, a glowing cyan holo-projection dome, server racks visible through windows, cable trays and antenna clusters. Olive-drab and gunmetal.
techlab.noctis: an organic cerebral nexus structure viewed from directly above, a large exposed ribbed brain-like mass suspended within a chitin cage, pulsing violet synaptic light, thin tendrils connecting it to the ground, wet glistening membrane.
techlab.veyra: a tall crystalline archive spire viewed from directly above, a slender white-gold ceramic tower surrounded by floating unsupported concentric data-rings inlaid with amethyst crystal, glowing glyphs etched into the surface, serene.

turret.aegis: a compact automated defense turret emplacement viewed from directly above, a rotating twin-barrel autocannon mount on an armoured bunker base, ammo feed belts, targeting sensor cluster, sandbag revetment. Olive-drab and gunmetal.
turret.noctis: an organic spine cannon structure viewed from directly above, a cluster of rigid bone spines erupting from a fleshy pulsating base, one spine cocked back ready to launch, glowing violet pressure sac at the root.
turret.veyra: an elegant crystalline prism battery viewed from directly above, a rotating faceted amethyst crystal lens mounted on a slender white-gold ceramic pedestal, floating unsupported focusing rings, a glowing charge core beneath.

detector.aegis: a compact sensor array building viewed from directly above, a small hardened bunker topped with a rotating dish and a cluster of thin whip antennae, a blinking cyan status light, cable spool at the base. Olive-drab and gunmetal.
detector.noctis: an organic seer node structure viewed from directly above, a small clustered stalk of eye-like bioluminescent sensory pods on short fleshy stalks, glowing violet, surrounded by fine sensing filaments radiating outward.
detector.veyra: an ornate crystalline oracle beacon viewed from directly above, a small floating unsupported amethyst crystal shard hovering above a white-gold ceramic base ring, radiating a faint visible sensor field pattern, serene glow.
